installed_metadata.method: Read distribution/build_info.json using .venv Python -I; no CAD or runtime creation

limitations: Draft assessment of source registration/contracts; not installed-wheel, MCP-chain or native acceptance of any practice.
partial means supporting operations exist within bounded contracts; it does not mean the complete practice can be executed.
guidance_only means procedural selection is available as advice, without a server implementation of that methodology.
unsupported means the defining action or verification is absent from the public MCP; listed tools provide context only.
Public names below are MCP tools, not dotted internal domain operations or general SolidWorks COM methods.
Observation, feature-tree, dimension and operation-specific revisions are distinct; no generic mutation/rebuild permission is implied.
Read-only summaries and internal BREP proofs are not an arbitrary public complete-body certificate.
Existing native save writes only an already-bound native file. First save of a new unsaved model is absent from this assessed baseline.

Pilot prerequisites are native W dependency, full W-edit-after-two-holes revision/shape scope, and first-save/reopen lifecycle with fresh references. Base-only W editing does not cover a perforated part.

Official source recommendations and internal/upstream examples do not establish public tool support, compatible COM calls or native acceptance. Stage 2.1 implementation follows the formal stage transition in PLAN.md.
Registry lifecycle and verification statuses remain unchanged; no practice becomes native_accepted through this assessment.

missing: General creation/readback of chosen dimensional dependencies
Native symmetry/equation/centering construction
Width editing of a base after adding holes or patterns within a complete guarded scope
practices.scope: Read supported dimensions/linear sketch and change independent parameters in their separate scopes. General dimension_set_value rejects sketch, linked, driven, equation and unsupported dependency contexts. Choosing engineering intent remains a skill procedure.

missing: Two-hole dependency x1=e, x2=W-e expressed and read in the native model
Width mutation after holes with full guarded two-hole state
Complete postconditions and persistence proof for the dependent pair
First native save of a new unsaved part
practices.scope: A rectangular base and one independent X/Y/diameter through-hole are available. LPattern can create a second instance at a fixed supplied spacing, but that is not a width-dependent constant-edge-offset pair. Creating a second independent hole on an already holed body is outside the single-hole contract. Existing file lifecycle tools do not prove the dependent scenario.

missing: Pair centering dependency x1=(W-P)/2, x2=(W+P)/2
Supported base/hole/pattern editing after array creation
Independent parameter P editing with complete dependent-state proof
practices.scope: LPattern supplies a native fixed spacing and 2..64 instances along positive local X/Y, seeded by an independent hole. The seed remains anchored by its X/Y. Fixed spacing does not imply centering under W changes; later editing is explicitly excluded.

missing: Arbitrary reference plane/origin creation and choice
General creation of positional sketch relations
Centered or custom datum profile construction within an accepted scope
practices.scope: A supported origin reference plane is an explicit persistent target. Base extrusion creates a fully defined rectangle with its corner at the true model origin; sketch_get reads the supported linear sketch including origin, plane and relations. This covers one corner-based method, not arbitrary datum selection.

missing: General selected relation creation/editing
Symmetry/equality/shared-parameter construction
Read and conflict analysis across arbitrary curved/external sketches
practices.scope: sketch_get reads complete supported planar linear points, lines, constrained status and relations; it rejects curved and unsupported external entities. Own circle constraints are read inside bounded hole preparation, not via sketch_get. Rectangle and circle creation generate fixed supported networks; no general relation editor is exposed.

missing: Feature construction dependent on rounded geometry
Public parent-child dependency graph
Radius editing or subsequent feature construction on an already rounded body
Multiple fillets or arbitrary feature reordering
practices.scope: One constant-radius full cuboid edge fillet is prepared/created and verified inside its bounded contract. The source is one plain rectangular base. No tangent propagation, face/variable/full-round fillets, further editing or form-generating fillet/boss chain is supported by this scope.

missing: Server selection/comparison of methods against engineering purpose
Shell and Rib construction/readback through public MCP
General composed feature scenarios and comparison under expected edits
practices.scope: The skill may inspect the implemented catalog and select among bounded alternatives: rectangular extrusion, full-turn base cylinder, corner through-cut, one hole, linear hole pattern or single-edge fillet. These are distinct source states, not freely composable tools. The Shell/Rib recommendation is advice with no executor in this catalog.

missing: Public closed parent-child dependency graph and mutation planner
Public complete equation/external-reference graph
Arbitrary feature reordering and dependent-parent edits
Save/reopen proof for the full proposed dependency scenario
practices.scope: Public tools read feature-tree metadata, explicit references, supported dimensions/sketch relations and durable outcomes. Internal feature.dependencies/dependency context has its own historical evidence but is not a registered MCP tool. feature_list is not a complete dependency graph, and summaries are not a deletion or reorder preview.

missing: Mate creation/readback
Degree-of-freedom and permitted-motion verification
Guarded assembly mutation and rebuild
practices.scope: Only passive fully resolved instance context, configuration and transform are available. Transform does not establish allowed motion, fixed state or a valid mate scheme. No selection, resolve or rebuild is performed; suppressed/lightweight/SpeedPak states reject this scope.

missing: Mate graph and base scheme review
Mate creation/editing and geometric reference verification
Guarded rebuild and functional scheme proof
practices.scope: Instance/body/face/edge references can provide explicit contextual targets for future mates. They are original-instance read targets with scoped lifetimes, not mate anchors accepted by a mutation tool. No mates or rigid hierarchy claims follow from component enumeration.

missing: Public external-reference creation and full dependency readback
Source-owner assignment and cycle analysis including mates
Guarded propagation of contextual parameters and assembly rebuild
practices.scope: Component context is passive. dimension_list/get refer to an explicit open part in its supported context, not an assembly instance parameter mutation. Internal dependency inventories and dimension write blockers do not provide a public external-reference editor or full assembly cycle analysis.

missing: Read/change of rigid/flexible solve mode
Configuration selection/preparation for poses
Continuous internal-motion validation and guarded assembly rebuild
practices.scope: Existing/reference configurations and current transforms can be observed without switching configuration. The public catalog neither selects rigid/flexible mode nor verifies internal motion. File open/save lifecycle does not implement this engineering operation.
